basic_profile.bio: ArtisticAviator82 is a 41-year-old digital artist and aviation enthusiast based in Seattle, Washington. They work as an IT consultant and have a passion for drawing aviation-themed art in their free time. Recently, they've been exploring digital art on their Galaxy Note9. They enjoy learning new techniques but often find themselves struggling with shaky hands when drawing. ArtisticAviator82 is single and often spends evenings and weekends online, especially on Reddit, where they participate in various communities. Despite their love for creativity, they have a strong dislike for overly critical comments and prefer constructive feedback. They are a night owl, usually online between 8 PM and 2 AM PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: ArtisticAviator82 has a background in information technology with over 15 years of experience. They are largely self-taught in digital art, having started with traditional media before transitioning to digital platforms. They frequently watch online tutorials and participate in online art challenges to enhance their skills.
